title: Everyday Phrases — At the Aquarium
title_quote: Are we going to the aquarium today?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🐠 實用水族館必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Aquarium
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用水族館情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從查票價、停車、排門票，到海底隧道看鯊魚水母、觸摸池問海星、看餵食秀、紀念品店和午餐，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Aquarium phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from ticket prices, parking and the entry line, to the underwater tunnel, the touch pool, the dolphin feeding show, the gift shop and lunch. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we going to the aquarium today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ər wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ði æˈkwɛriəm təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們今天要去水族館嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the kids are so excited.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the ticket prices online.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ˈtɪkɪt ˈpraɪsɪz ˈɑnˌlaɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much is one adult ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Adults pay twenty dollars each.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And child tickets are cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kids under three go in free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, our little one is two.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們家小的才兩歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy tickets right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the line gets long later.
dialogue.zh: 好，待一會兒隊伍會很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can just pay from my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn dʒʌst peɪ frʌm maɪ foʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that saves us time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is an annual pass option.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the yearly card worth it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two trips make it cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can come back in summer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let us get three passes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do passes include the parking lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, parking costs five more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can park on the side street.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn pɑrk ɑn ðə saɪd strit./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以停在旁邊的街邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the main lot fill by ten?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə meɪn lɑt fɪl baɪ tɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually it fills up fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we leave home at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set my phone for eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt maɪ foʊn fər eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我把手機鬧鐘設在八點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the place open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine thirty on weekends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any shows in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The feeding show starts at eleven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which animals eat then?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The seals eat first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we watch that one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we must be early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I find the schedule?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is posted by the big doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈpoʊstɪd baɪ ðə bɪɡ dɔrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me snap that sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, then we miss nothing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a stroller today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our girl walks slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will fold it into the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl foʊld ɪt ˈɪntu ðə kɑr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And bring the small backpack.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we pack inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two water bottles and some crackers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snacks are fine in the lobby.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But no food near the tanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, snacks only in the lobby.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one juice box for each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the aquarium cold inside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels cool, bring a sweater.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the kids wear warm shoes?
dialogue.zh: 孩子們要穿保暖的鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just comfy walking shoes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to print tickets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we show them on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the family entrance?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the big blue sign.
dialogue.zh: 在那個藍色大牌子旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The line is already long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a few more people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold my hand in the crowd.
dialogue.zh: 人多的時候牽好我的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I told them to stay close.
dialogue.zh: 我跟他們說過要待在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where does the line start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, wɛr dʌz ðə laɪn stɑrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It starts right at that pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About fifteen minutes, maybe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is not too bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids can look outside.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們可以先看看外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a model ship there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The boy loves those big sails.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are ready for our tickets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is my phone with the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz maɪ foʊn wɪð ðə koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 這是我的手機，上面有驗證碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are inside at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, the hall is so blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we go first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The map says left is best.
dialogue.zh: 地圖上說左邊最值得看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a bathroom nearby?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, past the little shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us go after this one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, but tell me early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone battery is low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a small power bank.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we rent an audio guide?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk lends them for free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is bright in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights shine on the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the sea turtle hall open?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it opens at ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still have time to spare.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us watch the sea lions.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those seats free here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them, no one is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The baby needs a nap soon.
dialogue.zh: 寶寶一下子就要睡午覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can rest in the café.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以去咖啡座休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have a room for nursing?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ hæv ə rum fər ˈnɜrsɪŋ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look for the family sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I lost my hat somewhere.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the stroller, look.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the wet wipes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two packs, right in the bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are ready for a fun day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ər ˈrɛdi fər ə fʌn deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們準備好開心玩一天了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids are running ahead.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們已經往前跑走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait for me at that door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you there in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step in, the tunnel starts here.
dialogue.zh: 進來，海底隧道從這裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, fish are all around us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look up at the big blue roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ʌp æt ðə bɪɡ blu ruf./
dialogue.zh: 抬頭看那片藍色的屋頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That water is over our heads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A school of fish went by.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They move like one long ribbon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many fish are in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a hundred, hard to count.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These little ones shine silver.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big dark ones scare me.
dialogue.zh: 那些黑黑的大魚好可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do those fish bite people?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they only eat small shrimp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the glass so thick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water pushes very hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we touch the glass here?
dialogue.zh: 我們在這裡可以摸玻璃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do not tap it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tapping hurts the animals.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tell the kids twice.
dialogue.zh: 我會好好提醒孩子們兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, something big is coming.
dialogue.zh: 看，有個大東西遊過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a big shark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is that shark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three meters, the sign says.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it heavy too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly four hundred kilos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is heavier than a piano.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it swims so quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are sharks mean or shy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most are shy, not mean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is this shark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The keeper says ten years.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the flat fish near the sand?
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə flæt fɪʃ nɪr ðə sænd?/
dialogue.zh: 看到沙邊那條扁扁的魚嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a ray with wings.
dialogue.zh: 那是一條長翅膀的魟魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a ray really fly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In water, it looks like flying.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a sting on its tail?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə stɪŋ ɑn ɪts teɪl?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, so never touch one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a turtle sleeps here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It floats with its eyes closed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is an adult turtle?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: As big as a table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that turtle eat plants?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it loves sea grass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does a turtle live?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighty years or more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fish has funny stripes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orange and white, like a clown.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do fish swim in pairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They stay safe together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now walk to the jellyfish room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights there change color.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue now, then pink, then green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is so calm to watch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do jellyfish have bones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they are mostly water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they dangerous to us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some sting, so do not touch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And some glow in the dark.
dialogue.zh: 而且有些會在暗處發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like little moon lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The purple tank is my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 紫色那個水箱是我最愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like the tall round one.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡那個高高的圓形箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the light so dim here?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə laɪt soʊ dɪm hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的燈光為什麼這麼暗？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep sea fish hate bright light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes need a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the rail and wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there an octopus here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hiding in the cave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see only one long arm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He peeks out, then hides.
dialogue.zh: 牠偷看一下，又躲起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A crab walked on the rock.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It raised both little claws.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep is this big tank?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine meters of salt water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much water fits in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A million liters, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who cleans all that glass?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A diver does it weekly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That job looks fun.
dialogue.zh: 那個工作看起來好好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe next time on a tour.
dialogue.zh: 也許下次參加導覽時能看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at my shadow on the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt maɪ ˈʃædoʊ ɑn ðə ɡlæs./
dialogue.zh: 看我映在玻璃上的影子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fish swam right through it.
dialogue.zh: 魚剛好從影子裡遊過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that long eel going?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the rock for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This part smells like the beach.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that salty air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the little boy scared?
dialogue.zh: 那個小男孩是不是害怕了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the shark made him cry.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那條鯊魚把他嚇哭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharks here cannot reach us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell him the glass is strong.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a baby shark weigh?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ə ˈbeɪbi ʃɑrk weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About as much as a dog.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sit on this bench?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以坐這張長椅嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, watch the tunnel from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to stay all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the fish do too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these animals sleep at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but very lightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We saw the seal show at eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɔ ðə sil ʃoʊ æt ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 我們十一點看到了海豹餵食秀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It balanced a ball on its nose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈbælənst ə bɔl ɑn ɪts noʊz./
dialogue.zh: 那隻海豹把球頂在鼻子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check the next sign.
dialogue.zh: 我們去看下一個指示牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we walk to the touch pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi wɔk tə ðə təʧ pul./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the touch pool sign.
dialogue.zh: 這裡就是觸摸池的牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The water looks warm and clear.
dialogue.zh: 水看起來暖暖的、很清澈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May we put our hands in?
dialogue.zh: 我們把手伸進去可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but be very gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First wash your hands here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is soap right by the tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz soʊp raɪt baɪ ðə tæp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a starfish on my hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels rough, like sand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many arms does one have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually five, sometimes six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it alive or dead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is alive, hold it flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not lift it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It needs water to breathe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sea urchin moved there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not touch that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are its spikes dangerous?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They poke your skin hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, a sea snail for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is cold and so smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The baby crab is tiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it back with care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who knows about these animals?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The keeper in blue does.
dialogue.zh: 穿藍衣服的那位管理員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can you help us?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，可以幫我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask me anything.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do starfish eat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny snails and small shells.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they have eyes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny ones on each arm tip.
dialogue.zh: 每條腕的尖端有一點小眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old is this starfish?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three years old.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it grow a new arm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, slowly, in months.
dialogue.zh: 可以，幾個月慢慢長回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please show us the horseshoe crab.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is older than dinosaurs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it safe for kids?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it stays very calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we hear a short talk?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以聽一段簡短的介紹嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The keepers talk here each hour.
dialogue.zh: 管理員每整點都在這裡講解。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we stand for it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the round pool steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time is the dolphin show?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve thirty and four again.
dialogue.zh: 十二點半，四點還有一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which show should we pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first show is less crowded.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does it last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a spot for the stroller?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə spɑt fər ðə ˈstroʊlər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at the back row.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do dolphins jump high there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very high, over the rope.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get a closer seat?
dialogue.zh: 能坐到近一點的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you will get wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring a bag for our phones.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, water flies far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to take pictures?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but no flash.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flash hurts the animals' eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will turn it off now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand by the rail with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smile, I am counting three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more with the whole family.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it to grandma tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the little girl crying?
dialogue.zh: 那個小女生為什麼在哭？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The loud music scared her.
dialogue.zh: 音樂太大聲把她嚇到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the noise too big here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let us step outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are soft ear covers.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them on, they help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sound comes from those speakers.
dialogue.zh: 聲音是從那些喇叭傳出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is only noise, no danger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold her during the loud part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is calm again now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the dolphin waves its tail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says hello to us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that big jump?
dialogue.zh: 你看到那個大跳躍了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I missed it, take a video.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is almost dead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it for the penguins.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this seat taken, excuse me?
dialogue.zh: 請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope, go ahead and sit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The keeper brings fish in a bucket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkipər brɪŋz fɪʃ ɪn ə ˈbʌkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 管理員提了一桶魚過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He feeds them one by one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the dolphins know him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they hear his call.
dialogue.zh: 認識，牠們聽得懂他的呼喚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many dolphins live here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, all born here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do they eat every day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lots of small fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my son feed one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only at the special tour.
dialogue.zh: 只有在專屬導覽時才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us ask about that tour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It costs ten more dollars.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will do it next visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go wash your hands before lunch.
dialogue.zh: 午餐前先去把手洗一洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The touch pool was their favorite.
dialogue.zh: 觸摸池是孩子們最喜歡的一站。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, I loved the starfish.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我好愛那些海星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where to next on the map?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The penguin yard for lunch.
dialogue.zh: 去企鵝區看牠們吃午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here are the penguins walking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They waddle in a small line.
dialogue.zh: 牠們排成小隊搖搖擺擺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do penguins live in cold places?
dialogue.zh: 企鵝住在很冷的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, mostly in the south.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do they stand on one foot?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ðeɪ stænd ɑn wʌn fʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 牠們為什麼都單腳站著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps them warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One jumped into the water!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It swam fast, just like a bird.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt swæm fæst, dʒʌst laɪk ə bɜrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How fast can a penguin swim?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster than I can run.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How big is a grown penguin?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close to eighty centimeters tall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do they get lunch?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At one, with the keeper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They eat frozen fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, that one took two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The otters are next door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They float on their backs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is eating on its chest.
dialogue.zh: 有一隻在胸口上吃東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It uses a small stone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do otters hold hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so they stay together.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their fur stays dry here.
dialogue.zh: 牠們的毛在這裡保持乾燥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It traps warm air inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we need our own lunch.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們自己也要吃午餐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The café is by the big tank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæˈfeɪ ɪz baɪ ðə bɪɡ tæŋk./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡座就在那個大水箱旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a table for four?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the open window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do they serve here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soup, sandwiches, and fruit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take a chicken soup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get me a cheese sandwich.
dialogue.zh: 幫我點一份起司三明治。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fries for the kids?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One order to share, plus two apples.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈɔrdər tə ʃɛr, plʌs tu ˈæpəlz./
dialogue.zh: 點一份大家分，再加兩顆蘋果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the milk cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it comes from the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the fruit cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, with a little yogurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the table first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I have the wipes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch your hot drink.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will use both hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bird landed on the rail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not give it bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we throw the trash?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue box near the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let us visit the shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is right by the exit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at all those soft toys!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blue whale is so big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which one do you want?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small orange fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is that penguin?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is twelve, on the tag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a shell necklace too.
dialogue.zh: 我也想要一條貝殼項鍊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rack is on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we buy two for the price of one?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi baɪ tu fər ðə praɪs əv wʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only today, the sign says.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have this in green?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look up, top shelf.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I open this box?
dialogue.zh: 我可以打開這個盒子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep the tag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do cards get a discount here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, members save ten percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use the card machine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine needs your code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them in one bag.
dialogue.zh: 全部裝在一個袋子裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big turtle is for dad.
dialogue.zh: 那隻大海龜是送爸爸的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He will love this gift.
dialogue.zh: 他一定會喜歡這個禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little gift to take home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The baby is asleep already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You carry her, my arms hurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us leave the crowd now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stroller is full of bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The boy wants a carry too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the orange fish.
dialogue.zh: 把那條橘色小魚玩偶給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last stop on the way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The exit desk is close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get a stamp here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, at the exit desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my visitor card?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I kept it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it down slowly now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look, a clean blue star.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want five more stamps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some for next time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was the day for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shark was my favorite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I liked the starfish most.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the otters made me laugh.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we come back soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our pass lasts a year.
dialogue.zh: 可以，我們的年卡有效一年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us plan it for Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it on the fridge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring the car keys?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus the extra water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say bye to the fish.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids waved at the glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We got home late but happy.
dialogue.zh: 我們到家時很晚，但很快樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids slept in the car.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們在車上就睡著了。
